---
title: "Project records"
---
How the collection is built and checked, kept public because the project is open and invites help. None of this is needed to use the data.

1. [Decisions](../decisions.qmd): the decisions that shaped the method, with their options.
2. [Review](../review/index.qmd): the record of human checks, and every value that rests on one reading only.
3. [Open questions](../open-questions.qmd): what could not be settled, with the evidence, and how to help.
4. [Methods](../methods/index.qmd): data organization, the reading rules and how the agents work.
5. [Insights](../insights/index.qmd): judgment and caveats the report authors recorded.
6. [Figures](../figures/index.qmd) and [Sources](../sources/index.qmd): every figure of the report sections indexed, and the register of sources.

## Coverage

Single physical tests by soil and state (rows) and test type (columns). A zero means the report documents no such test in the pages inventoried so far. A state marked `printed; not a numbered soil` is printed beside the test but is not one of the twelve soils of the report's soil table (for example dense red scoria ([RS]{.term title="red crushed volcanic scoria, narrowly graded" tabindex="0"}) at a relative density ([Dr]{.term title="relative density: 0 at the soil's maximum void ratio (loosest) and 1 at its minimum (densest), from the reference void-ratio limits; a bed packed past the reference densest state reads above 1" tabindex="0"}) of 0.94 to 0.97).

## Five counts that measure different things

| count | value | what it counts |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Indexed records | 348 | rows in the experiment index: single tests, averaged and derived series, correlations, text summaries and bin samples |
| Single physical tests | 142 | rows of kind `single`: one physical test on one bed |
| Tests with complete printed setup | 4 | rows whose bed state, apparatus geometry, bin and loading rate are all printed in the source |
| Observation series extracted | 192 | experiments with an `observations.csv` (digitized points) in `data/experiments/` |
| Human audits recorded | 3360 | rows in `qa/audits.csv`; agreement between the two agents is not an audit |

## Open decisions

- **D-015** (2026-10-07): Apollo-era sources only or also later simulant data? Options: Apollo era only; also later simulant data (GRC-1 and JSC-1A and successors).
